[left]Thank you to everyone who downloaded this mod when it was still new and let me know what areas still needed some work! I greatly appreciate those who also left such kind comments as well! 

Here's what you can expect from this mod:

[list]
[*]Over 40+ different kinds of fairies who will bake sweets and pastries for you everyday! The many different kinds are on based Vanilla items, as well as items from the Cornucopia mod! The Cornucopia mod is not required, but is highly recommended!
[/list] ﻿﻿- Due to the amount of variety, I have separated these out into 4 different shop icons to assist those who want to easily acquire their preferred fairies.

[*]Each fairy will drop customized sweets based upon their fruit/flavor theme in addition to vanilla assets.
[*]Buildable bakery for the fairies to call home, complete with a kitchen so they can bake to their heart's content, as well as some chairs so they can rest their wings when they need to. Exterior also changes with the seasons!
[*]If you have any of the below mods installed, you may just see additional fruit, pastries and sweets drops:

[list]
[*][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/29997]Livestock Bazaar[/url]﻿ - This will allow the option to pick which fairies you want to buy.

[*][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/30323]Unlimited Storage[/url]﻿ - Cross-mod compatibility adds a ton of additional drop possibilities based on what you have installed. You might want to have a bigger chest.
[/list]
